title_en: Residential buildings up to 12.5 m — exterior open spaces (front, rear, side)
title_hi: आवासीय भवन (12.5 मी. तक) — बाहरी खुली जगह (सामने, पीछे, बगल)
interpretation_notes: Applies only to residential buildings with height up to 12.5 m (56(5) sends taller buildings to Rule 42). Table rows are read as: 'Up to X' = less than or equal to X; 'More than X / Above X' = strictly greater than X. Side open space: for semi-detached the 'one side' is taken as the larger of the two entered side setbacks. The provisos ('may be reduced') are discretionary; the engine treats them as the minimum the rule permits.

rows.quote: 2. More than 9.0 meters and up to 12 meters 3.6 meters

rows.label: More than 12.0 meters and up to 18 meters
rows.quote: 3. More than 12.0 meters and up to 18 meters 4.5 meters

exceptions.text_en: In existing developed areas with streets narrower than 6.0 m, the building line is 6.0 m from the centre line of the street.
exceptions.text_hi: पहले से विकसित क्षेत्रों में 6.0 मी. से कम चौड़ी सड़क होने पर भवन रेखा सड़क की मध्य रेखा से 6.0 मी. पर होगी।
exceptions.quote: (b) In existing developed areas with streets less than 6.0 meters in width, the distances of the building (building line) shall be at 6.0 meters from the center line of the street.

source.quote: Every Residential Building having height up to 12.5 meters, facing street shall have a front open space mentioned below and such open space shall form an integral part of the site

checks.explain_hi: {plot_area_sqm} वर्ग मी. के प्लॉट के लिए नियम 56(2)(a) के अनुसार पीछे की न्यूनतम खुली जगह {required} मी. है।
